findings.body:
Gain 5, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - accepting remaining findings with `forge close <item> --resolve accept --reason ...`.
The acceptance path still pushes at src/forge/close.py:156 for an owner-resolved stop, then continues to this final push. Between them, spotted.record() closes accepted findings' open entries (src/forge/spotted.py:261–268), and close.py:421–422 commits that bookkeeping. The command therefore successfully updates the branch twice and restarts CI, leaving the requested fix unmet. Defer the acceptance path's first push until this final publication. The publication-count test covers ordinary and replay closes but never invokes `--resolve accept`, so it misses this defect.
